messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up: running a small dry-run to merge duplicate contacts and reconcile owner mismatches this Thursday 10am PT. Goal: reduce noise in health scoring and avoid double-touch nudges. Need someone to run the selector and validate merge candidates. :mag:

Priya: I can run the selector. What's the dedupe logic? fuzzy name + email norm + same account?

Sam: Proposed logic: email_normalized match OR (same phone AND name fuzzy_score > 0.85) AND account_id same. Flag if owners differ or more than one primary contact. Exclude contacts with recent inbound support in last 14d. Sample = 200 rows.

Liam: Add rule to not auto-merge when both contacts have distinct product_activity > 5 in last 30d. We don't want to remove active users. Also exclude contacts with `legal_representative` tag.

Priya: SQL I will run (rough):
```sql
SELECT c1.id AS contact_a, c2.id AS contact_b, c1.account_id, c1.owner_id AS owner_a, c2.owner_id AS owner_b, levenshtein(lower(c1.name), lower(c2.name)) AS name_dist
FROM crm.contacts c1
JOIN crm.contacts c2 ON c1.account_id = c2.account_id AND c1.id < c2.id
WHERE (lower(trim(c1.email)) = lower(trim(c2.email))
   OR (c1.phone = c2.phone AND levenshtein(lower(c1.name), lower(c2.name)) < 5))
  AND c1.last_inbound_at < now() - interval '14 days'
  AND c2.last_inbound_at < now() - interval '14 days'
LIMIT 200;
```

Nora: For the UI flow, we should set a `merge_suggestion` flag only — not perform merges automatically. CS console will show suggestions with a "propose merge" button. Also show a diff of fields and recommended canonical owner.

Sam: Agreed. We will write to `crm.suggested_merges` table and surface in dashboard. No canonical score changes yet. But we should test a healthscore recalibration where duplicates previously inflated counts (eg. contact_count metric). Proposal: compute an "effective_contact_count" excluding suggested merges and show a temp recalibrated healthscore in CS console.

Liam: Ops concern: merging contacts upstream can break integrations. Keep only suggestion and provide an export to owners so they can approve. Also add rollback metadata (who accepted, timestamp).

ops-bot: scheduled: dry-run job queued for 2025-09-04T17:00:00Z by user Sam

Priya: done. pushed sample CSV to /shared/cs/dedupe/samples/dedupe_sample_1747554321.csv and inserted 200 rows into crm.suggested_merges with source_tag = 'dryrun-1747554321'.

Nora: Reviewing now. Noticed 7 cases where owner is blank -> mark as `unassigned` and surface to owners queue.

Sam: For scoring test, create `health_score_effective` = base_score - min(2, duplicate_contact_inflation) and surface as temporary column only. Will it be confusing?

Liam: Limit change visibility: only show `health_score_effective` to CS and not to billing/reporting exports. Add a schema flag `visibility = 'cs_ui'` when we write to analytics dataset.

Priya: Found one edge-case: two emails that normalize to same after plus-address stripping but different owners; keep suggestion but don't auto-assign owner.

Nora: I'll draft the dashboard tooltip and runbook blurb: "Suggested merges are non-destructive. Approve in console to commit changes. Contact merge may affect historical touch attribution." Will put in Confluence: /confluence/cs/dedupe-runbooks/dryrun-1747554321

Sam: Let's meet 9:50am PT tomorrow for a quick review before the 10am dry-run. 15 min in #customer-success.

Liam: added rate-limit on owner notifications: 1 notification per owner per 12h for merge suggestions.

Priya: canary done: marked 20 high-confidence pairs with `confidence = high` and tagged owners. Waiting on owner ack.

Nora: owner ack received for 5 pairs. Good to proceed with full dry-run.

Sam: Thanks team. After dry-run we'll collect owner feedback, then plan a staged rollout for suggestion flows across all accounts. Will post results here. :white_check_mark:
